lines.zh: 我顺着树根间的暗水游。
lines.en: I swim the dark water between jungle roots.

lines.zh: 藤蔓垂到水面，我穿过去。
lines.en: Vines hang to the water; I slip through.
The water in the jungle is warm.
I flick my tail and fallen leaves spin.
The channel is narrow, so I turn sideways.
I swim steady as a plank.
A fallen fruit splashes in and I dodge.
My companion and I swim offset, one behind.
The bed is soft; one fin sweep clouds it.
I follow the shade of a fallen log.

lines.zh: 雨林的水一年到头都满。
lines.en: Jungle water stays full all year.
A film of pollen floats on the surface.
I push along over the waterweed.
The water is cooler deep in the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 我游过树影，鳞上一阵暗一阵亮。
lines.en: I swim through the shade, my scales dark, then bright.

lines.zh: 水底的叶子太多，我绕了两圈。
lines.en: Too many leaves on the bottom, so I circle twice.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边游，那里虫子多。
lines.en: I swim along the bank, where the bugs are.

lines.zh: 一截枯枝漂过来，我从下面钻过。
lines.en: A dead branch drifts by; I slip beneath it.
I hold still between the tree roots.

lines.zh: 我张大嘴，等东西漂进来。
lines.en: I open wide and wait for something to drift in.
The water carries a sweet-sour fruit smell.
My companion circles under the log.
Green light glints along my scales.
The jungle is loud; I cannot be bothered to move.
I open and close my gill covers slowly.
Half a rotted fruit is buried in the mud.
I do not eat the bugs on the surface.

lines.zh: 我在数从叶缝落下的水滴。
lines.en: I count drips falling through the leaves.

lines.zh: 这里的水够深，藏得住我。
lines.en: The water here is deep enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，靠着一块石头。
lines.en: I lean sideways against a stone.
The jungle damp suits me.

lines.zh: 我等着果实自己掉下来。
lines.en: I wait for fruit to fall on its own.

lines.zh: 我在水里悬着，尾鳍慢慢晃。
lines.en: I hang in the water, tail fin swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 热带的雨下到水里，一圈一圈。
lines.en: Tropical rain reaches the water, ring after ring.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，脚边全是藤。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, vines at your feet.

lines.zh: 水把你的倒影拉得很长。
lines.en: The water stretches your reflection long.
You lean down, so I swim a little closer.
I watch you from the leaf shadows.
You are blocking the jungle light.

lines.zh: 你的手在水里晃，像果子。
lines.en: Your hand sways in the water like fruit.

lines.zh: 我眼睛长在头两侧，看得全。
lines.en: My eyes sit at both sides; I see it all.
Do not step through that fallen log.
You carry the smell of smoke.
We look at each other; no one else is in the water.
One move from you and the leaves rustle.

lines.zh: 我认得你踩过的这片泥。
lines.en: I know this mud you have stepped in.
Two of my scales got scraped off.
The water clouded at once.
My tail is beating fast.
Three hearts do not last many hits.
I dive under the tree roots.
The blow left my gills numb.
The pain makes me tip sideways.
Mud has washed into the wound.
Do not strike my gill covers.
It will be a while before I can swim.
Fruit smell; I caught it.
Is the one you are holding ripe yet?
I do not eat bread; give me fruit.

lines.zh: 水一晃，我就知道有东西。
lines.en: The water stirs and I know something is there.

lines.zh: 我张嘴就能把它吸进去。
lines.en: I can suck it down as soon as I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 你把果子扔远点，我来追。
lines.en: Throw the fruit farther and I will chase it.
Jungle fruit is sweeter than this.

lines.zh: 我游过去要穿过那片水草。
lines.en: To get there I must cross that patch of weed.
That is not enough for two fish.
I bite loudly; do not be alarmed.
My teeth are flat, made for grinding fruit.

lines.zh: 你手伸进水里，我就靠近。
lines.en: Put your hand in and I will come close.
One bite and the seeds will spill out.
I am greedy, though not a fast swimmer.

lines.zh: 你手心那点红，是熟透的吧。
lines.en: That red in your palm, is it ripe?

lines.zh: 你把果子放下，我自己会来。
lines.en: Set the fruit down; I will come on my own.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞了我的背。
lines.en: You stepped in and hit my back.
The tree root is harder than you.

lines.zh: 你和我撞出一片白水花。
lines.en: Our collision threw up a sheet of spray.
I backed half a step to clear the stone.
Your knee brushed my scales.

lines.zh: 这水道太窄，容不下两个。
lines.en: This channel is too narrow for two.
There is a log underwater; do not step on it.
I bumped you because there was nowhere to go.
Between us we churned the water to mud.
You go first; I will wait for you to pass.
We swim as a pair and never split.
The edge of her fin carries a little red.
We circle beneath the fallen log.
The jungle has plenty of water for young.
I nudge her gently with my head.
Two is enough; more would crowd us.

lines.zh: 她拐进树根，我随后跟上。
lines.en: She turns into the roots and I follow.
This stretch is shallow, good for a home.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着那片水草。
lines.en: We take turns guarding that patch of weed.
Do not wade in and disturb us now.

lines.zh: 你把我从树根间捞起来。
lines.en: You pulled me out from between the roots.
Out of water I go stiff.
My scales are slick; your grip will fail.
Put me back in that dark channel.

lines.zh: 我在你手里拍了两下尾。
lines.en: I slapped my tail twice in your hands.
Your hands smell of fruit.
Do not press my gill covers.
I am this small; catching me gains you little.
Water drips from my mouth.
I know the way back to the channel.
I had no plan to bother with you.
You crushed that pile of fruit.
I have fixed on you, right here in the water.
This channel has no other exit.
My tail is already drawn straight.
You just kicked my companion.
My teeth are flat, but they grip.
I am going to ram your shin.
Do not think the bank keeps you safe.
This patch of weed belongs to us.
I close in along the waterweed.
Your foot is still in the water.
I slip behind the tree root.
Two more tailbeats and I am there.
The ripples are heading your way.
I have lowered my dorsal fin.
You have not looked into the water yet.
I hold until your next step lands.
The leaves are blocking your view.
The target is the ankle, nothing else.
I rammed your ankle.
That bite caught only water.
My flat teeth make a dull bite.
Step back once and I will stop.
I hit so hard I flipped over.
The splash landed on your own face.
Three hearts; I dare not fight long.

lines.zh: 你踩疼了才记得水里有鱼。
lines.en: You only remember the fish once it hurts.
After the blow I slip into a root gap.
Next time my bite will not miss.

lines.zh: 我从树根下的暗水里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the dark water under the roots.

lines.zh: 这片丛林水道正好容身。
lines.en: This jungle channel is just right for me.
The leaves are still dripping.

lines.zh: 我和同伴一前一后到了。
lines.en: My companion and I arrived one after the other.

lines.zh: 水底的落叶被我搅起来。
lines.en: I stir up the sunken leaves.
The trees are so tall that little light gets through.
I smell fruit and wet mud.
The water is still enough to mirror leaves.

lines.zh: 我从远处游了很长一段。
lines.en: I swam a long way to get here.
The water is warm here; I will stay.
The water heats up and I flee deeper.

lines.zh: 我从水里被甩到落叶堆上。
lines.en: I was flung from the water onto the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我就在水里活着，别按我。
lines.en: I live in water; do not hold me under.
The blast choked the channel with mud.
An arrow split the water and skimmed my back.

lines.zh: 咒语在水里发亮，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The spell glows in the water and blinds me.
No fruit has fallen from the trees in ages.

lines.zh: 雷打进水道，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the channel and I went rigid.

lines.zh: 水道底下空了，我在坠落。
lines.en: No bed below me now, only falling.
